items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I enjoyed having him in my band and as a friend

ctx.x: So can we talk a little about Eric? Because it seems like you had Alphonse Mouzon coming out of Weather Report and when Alphonse left Weather Report, Eric Gravatt came in. Alphonse leaves your group and you have Wilby Fletcher for a minute, then all of the sudden here comes Eric Gravatt, and then Eric Gravatt keeps appearing later on. So let’s talk about that relationship with Eric.

Eric is a fellow Philadelphian and he had a good reputation. He was with Weather Report with Joe Zawinul, but as a person I really enjoyed having him in the band. He was very creative rhythmically. I mean he studied African music so he could play any of those rhythms from any of those tribes in Africa. He was very ethnically orientated, so that was great because I liked the African rhythms as well, so we kind of came together and we created an atmosphere rhythmically and harmonically as well because he was a good…
Now when you say Joe, are you talking about Joe Zawinul or Joe Ford?
